name: USAA Eagle Navigator Visa Signature

apr.notes: Balance transfer, convenience check and cash advance fee is 5% of each transaction (cash advance fee waived for electronic transfers to a USAA Bank deposit account).

credit_required.notes: USAA membership is required to apply.

categories.label: Travel and transit (air, hotel, car and vacation rentals, rideshare, tolls and more)

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for travel, cash back, gift cards and more. Reward points never expire.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 bonus points after spending $3,000 on qualifying purchases by January 31, 2027.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.description: Cell phone protection listed on the USAA card page; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide for terms.

benefits.title: Extended warranty protection
benefits.description: Extended warranty protection listed on the USAA card page; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide for terms.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck or Global Entry credit
benefits.description: Statement credit up to $120 every four years toward the TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application or renewal fee.

benefits.title: 10,000 bonus points each calendar year
benefits.description: Earn 10,000 bonus points (equals $100 in travel) once every calendar year after a single USAA Rewards Center booking that includes at least $100 in spend, a hotel or car rental, and redeems at least 100 points.

notes: The page also lists travel accident insurance and auto deductible reimbursement (not offered in Washington State); see the Credit Card Benefits Guide.
